deployment_framework.strategy: Internal integration, private alpha, controlled beta, then public readiness.

required_secrets.name: Sentry DSN and alert integration credentials

deployment_environments.name: staging
deployment_environments.purpose: Production-like integration, smoke, alert, migration, and rollback rehearsal

deployment_checklist.action: Complete the Stage 6 production-runtime revision and readiness audit.
Confirm target platforms, release owner, approver, regions, and data residency.
Provision isolated staging services and inject secrets outside source control.
Run tests, type checks, lint, and a real production build.
Apply versioned staging migrations and verify tenant isolation.
Deploy web and worker release candidates and verify hosted health checks.
Execute website import, PDF import, manual entry, provider fallback, retry, cancel, and discovery-to-catalog smoke tests.
Rehearse rollback, queue pause/replay, and migration recovery.
Record evidence and request private-alpha approval.

controls: Rollback Vercel web deployment to the last verified release
Pause queue intake while preserving job events and source artifacts
Disable a degraded provider/connector through configuration
Prefer a tested forward fix for database migrations unless rollback is proven
rollback_plan.user_and_data_impact: Imports may pause during recovery; source artifacts, candidates, and job history must remain replayable.

migration_plan.strategy: Versioned Prisma migrations with staging rehearsal and explicit forward-fix/rollback decision.
migration_plan.blocker: Only a schema contract exists; no migration history is present.

seed_data_plan.strategy: Use synthetic tenant-scoped fixtures only; do not copy production customer data into staging.

deployment_risks.risk: Target platforms and ownership are assumed from Stage 5 but not confirmed.
deployment_risks.mitigation: Confirm platform, region, owner, budget, and approval path before provisioning.

assumptions.assumption: Private alpha is the next permitted release phase after staging evidence passes.
assumptions.next_action: Use LAUNCH-GATE-001 as the approval boundary.
